This is the exhaustive keyword-path companion to the
[ODCS validation matrix]({{ '/standards/odcs-validation/' | relative_url }}).
Version: **ODCS 3.2.0**, JSON Schema **2019-09**.
[Official source](https://github.com/bitol-io/open-data-contract-standard/blob/v3.2.0/schema/odcs-json-schema-v3.2.0.json).
Source SHA-256: `edb41f33ec46e84780e99872ab2bd67f074959d2bf3e9c9fc54e61f8982b0d93`.

Each of the **1070 entries** identifies an assertion, reference or applicator at
its exact JSON Pointer. Origin for every row is the official ODCS companion schema;
layer is JSON Schema (format assertions depend on validator configuration).
Packata does not execute this artifact. The status column describes that missing
enforcement layer, not the absence of equivalent individual semantic checks.
The matrix records those implemented/partial checks, code/tests and gap tracking.

References apply at every use site, including recursive nested properties, items
and map members. A branch's assertions apply only when selected by its parent
applicator: allOf requires all, anyOf at least one, oneOf exactly one; if selects
then/else. A false schema prohibits that location. Required means presence, not
non-empty text. Properties does not itself require a member. Omitted closure
keywords permit additional members. Defaults, examples, descriptions and deprecation
are annotations and are intentionally excluded; they do not reject input or fill defaults.

Regenerate with Node.js 22+ from the repository root:

```console
node .github/scripts/Generate-OdcsValidationInventory.mjs path/to/odcs-json-schema-v3.2.0.json
node .github/scripts/Generate-OdcsValidationInventory.mjs path/to/odcs-json-schema-v3.2.0.json --check
```
